raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated specific burial details ("Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery" in Chandler) that were not present in the visible viewport or the extracted metadata of the Wikipedia page it was analyzing. While the Wikipedia page correctly stated he died in Chandler, the agent incorrectly inferred a specific cemetery name and location for burial based on that death location, creating a false conflict with the verified Find a Grave data (City of Mesa Cemetery). This error led to an unnecessary and confusing step in the investigation where the Planner had to resolve a discrepancy between a hallucinated fact and a verified fact.
